title: Box Office Milestone: ‘Super Mario Galaxy’ Soars Past $300M in U.S. and $600M Globally
summary: 'Project Hail Mary' is also approaching the $300 million milestone. Elsewhere at the weekend box office, 'The Drama' gains traction and the new Black rom-com 'You, Me & Tuscany' opens.
contentText: In only its second weekend, 'Super Mario Galaxy Movie' crossed $300 million domestically and $600 million globally, while 'Hail Mary' soars past $500 million worldwide. Elsewhere, 'The Drama' gains traction and the new Black rom-com 'You, Me & Tuscany' opens.
